title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mild to warm pattern continues this weekend with rough surf, high tide - ABC7 Bay Area

AccuWeather Forecast: Mild to warm pattern continues this weekend with rough surf, high tide - ABC7 San Francisco 
 24/7 Live San Francisco East Bay South Bay Peninsula North Bay WEATHER 
 AccuWeather Forecast: Mild to warm pattern continues this weekend with rough surf, high tide 
 Saturday, November 7, 2026 12:51AM 
 ABC7 Eyewitness News Meteorologist Sandhya Patel has the AccuWeather forecast. Takeaway of the Day The mild to warm fall weather will continue this weekend. Watch out for rough surf and high tide flooding. A Beach Hazards Statement remains in effect until 10 p.m. Monday with breakers between twelve to sixteen feet bringing the risk of sneaker waves and rip currents. Above average high tides will cause flooding in low lying areas. The next high tide will be 7.4 feet in San Francisco at 9:38 a.m. Temperatures will drop by morning to the low 40s to the low 50s. Afternoon highs will come in above average again ranging from the upper 60s to the low 80s with a mix of sun and passing high clouds.
 A Look Ahead It turns a little cooler on Monday, but temperatures will bounce back Tuesday. Expect a chance of showers by next Friday and the pattern may remain unsettled into the weekend.
